reasons.text: This claim shares an address with another claim (ff9ff144-82bc-52b1-bbfe-c388c3398321). Under the program's claim policy, any shared address sends the claim to a person for review together with the matched claim.
The sewn-in label photo is legible and shows model AD10004LS, which is on the recalled list, so the model is confirmed.
The retailer Amazon.com is on the sale list and the purchase date 2024-02-13 is inside the sale window, so the purchase check passes with no receipt required.

The destruction photo is not yet confirmed as compliant: the instructed 'RECALLED' marking on the rear of the seatback is not visible, so the destruction check is incomplete. A person reviewing the flag should also check this.
The refund requested is $180.23, which is over the $100.00 threshold, so a person reviews it regardless.
